sentences.text:
In Re: Jahangir Sk on 21 February, 2023 21.02.2023 Sl. No.37 [Rejected] C. R. M. (DB) 684 of 2023 In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 14.02.2023 in connection with Purbasthali Police Station Case No.109 of 2022 dated 30.05.2022 under Sections 498A/302/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In Re: Jahangir Sk.
... ... Petitioner Mr. Jyoti Prakash Chatterjee ... ... for the petitioner Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee ..
ld.
Mr. Aniket Mitra ... ... for the State
Heard the learned Advocates appearing for both the parties.
We have considered the materials on record.
Dying declaration of the victim noted in the medical papers show petitioner had forced her to consume poison.
In view of gravity of the offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
The application for bail is thus rejected.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
